note: Controlled vocabularies for the `classification` block of works and manuscripts. Form, technique, support and condition describe the object and belong to the factual layer when observed or documented. Subjects are an editorial index for finding things, not a claim about meaning. Anything contested (attribution, function as preparatory for a given work, identification of a sitter) is a claim, never a classification value.

painting.label: Painting
painting.def: Autonomous painted work on a movable support (panel, canvas).

mural.label: Mural painting
mural.def: Painting on a wall or ceiling, whatever the technique.

cartoon.label: Cartoon
cartoon.def: Full scale drawing made for transfer to a painting.

drawing.label: Drawing
drawing.def: Drawing made for its own sake, neither a study for something else nor a presentation piece.

finished_drawing.label: Finished drawing
finished_drawing.def: Drawing carried to a high degree of finish, as a presentation or autonomous work.

study.label: Study
study.def: Drawing that works out a figure, motif or detail, usually on a single subject.

sheet_of_studies.label: Sheet of studies
sheet_of_studies.def: Sheet carrying several studies, often of different subjects or dates, with or without notes.

sketch.label: Sketch
sketch.def: Rapid exploratory drawing, compositional or of an idea in progress.

technical_drawing.label: Technical drawing
technical_drawing.def: Drawing of a machine, device, mechanism or engineering scheme, with or without notes.

architectural_drawing.label: Architectural drawing
architectural_drawing.def: Plan, elevation, section or view of a building or urban scheme.

map.label: Map
map.def: Cartographic drawing: town plan, regional or hydrographic map.

diagram.label: Diagram
diagram.def: Geometric, optical or scientific figure accompanying text.

illustration.label: Illustration
illustration.def: Drawing made to illustrate a text by another author, or printed after Leonardo's design.

sculpture_project.label: Sculpture project
sculpture_project.def: Sculptural commission known through documents, drawings or models.

architectural_project.label: Architectural project
architectural_project.def: Building or urban commission or proposal, as a project rather than one drawing.

engineering_project.label: Engineering project
engineering_project.def: Hydraulic, military or civil engineering undertaking, as a project rather than one drawing.

decoration_project.label: Decoration or festival project
decoration_project.def: Stage machinery, festival design, costume, ephemeral decoration.

secco_mural.label: Mural technique on dry plaster (secco, tempera and oil)

lost_known_from_copies.label: Lost, known from copies or descriptions

notebook.label: Notebook
notebook.def: A notebook used as such by Leonardo, surviving with its original gathering structure, whether or not rebound.

pocket_notebook.label: Pocket notebook
pocket_notebook.def: A small format notebook carried for notes in the field.

compiled_codex.label: Compiled codex
compiled_codex.def: A volume assembled after Leonardo's death from separate sheets or notebooks (e.g. by Pompeo Leoni).

sheet_collection.label: Collection of sheets
sheet_collection.def: Loose or remounted sheets kept as a collection, not as one volume.

treatise_compilation.label: Compilation by another hand
treatise_compilation.def: A text compiled or copied from Leonardo's notes by someone else (e.g. Melzi's Libro di pittura).
